summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a Form 6-K dated 3 November 2026, its routine foreign-private-issuer current report under the 1934 Act (the US equivalent of a domestic 8-K). The filing comprises cover-page and signature pages executed by Chief Financial Officer Charl Keyter plus an exhibit index listing one item, Exhibit 99.1 'Market release,' whose text is absent from the excerpt; the remainder is graphic-encoded image data. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timeline are disclosed. No special-situation event is evidenced; monitor for the underlying release content.
